arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-account-routing.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$root"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$root"
python3 -B - "$root" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
for file,ranges in (
 ('scripts/organic_growth.py',[(228,345)]),
 ('scripts/safe_runtime.py',[(505,550),(568,612),(620,673)]),
 ('scripts/operation_policy.py',[(1,66),(205,270)]),
 ('tests/test_organic_growth.py',[(219,285)]),
):
 p=root/file; ls=p.read_text().splitlines()
 print('FILE',file,'TOTAL_LINES',len(ls))
 for start,end in ranges:
  for i in range(start-1,min(len(ls),end)):
   print(f'{i+1}:{ls[i]}')
print('ROOT_SHA_FILE_VERSION')
PY
printf 'REPO_SHA='; git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD
grep -R -n -E 'supervisor|notif|telegram' "$root"/scripts/operation_policy.py "$root"/scripts/leads_operational_report.py "$root"/scripts/safe_runtime.py | tail -n 45
